item.title: JetSearch WordPress Plugin Unauthenticated SQL Injection (CVE-2026-49079)

Summary

JetSearch’s AJAX handlers (invoked via WordPress’s admin-ajax.php) fail to properly escape/parameterize user-supplied search parameters, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform SQL injection against the underlying WordPress database. The PoC (CVE-2026-49079.py) attempts to fingerprint the plugin and its version, discovers candidate AJAX action names (from page source or a built-in default list), and then submits crafted search_term payloads to wp-admin/admin-ajax.php to confirm injection and extract data via UNION-based queries — targeting wp_users credentials, wp_options, and wp_posts content, plus offering standalone time-based, boolean-based, and error-based payload generators.
